'''T4-B4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed near the dead forest of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]]. The droid discovered that the Imperial forces were jamming signals with jamming devices, making it difficult for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and local [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] to coordinate defenses and counter-attacks.<ref name="Openingchannel" />
